system_name.reference: We release ColPali , a Vision Language Model trained to produce high-quality multi-vector embeddings from images of document pages.
system_name.matched_span: We release ColPali , a Vision Language Model trained to produce high-quality multi-vector embeddings from images of document pages.

system_category.reference: To benchmark current systems on visually rich document retrieval, we introduce the Visual Document Retrieval Benchmark ViDoRe , composed of various page-level retrieval tasks spanning multiple domains, languages, and practical settings.
system_category.matched_span: To benchmark current systems on visually rich document retrieval, we introduce the Visual Document Retrieval Benchmark ViDoRe , composed of various page-level retrieval tasks spanning multiple domains, languages, and practical settings.

knowledge_representation.reference: Documents are visually rich structures that convey information through text, but also figures, page layouts, tables, or even fonts.

retrieval_mechanism.reference: Combined with a late interaction matching mechanism, ColPali largely outperforms modern document retrieval pipelines while being drastically simpler, faster and end-to-end trainable.

knowledge_source.reference: Indexing a standard PDF document involves several steps. First, PDF parsers or Optical Character Recognition (OCR) systems are used to extract words from the pages.
